translations.web: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.
translations.bsb: From Judah: 6,800 armed troops bearing shields and spears.
translations.kjv: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.
translations.asv: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, armed for war.
